**Inspecting rate limiting**

I need to take a closer look at rate limiting. It's essential to understand how it works, especially when dealing with requests and ensuring that systems aren't overwhelmed. I want to evaluate the thresholds and how they impact performance. Also, I'll consider any potential implications for user experience if rate limits are too strict. Let’s get started on gathering some data around this and see what adjustments, if any, might be necessary!

Premise correction: no per-user API rate-limiting middleware is registered in this repository, so no request limits are defined. The only middleware registered server-wide is recovery/CORS (`server/server.go:50-52`); image processing has a concurrency semaphore, not API rate limiting (`server/router/api/v1/attachment_service.go:160`).
